inputs.modified_text: I just heard that workers from the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth support programmes protested right outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a full 24-hour strike. They're demanding legally binding job security guarantees, but the government is pushing back hard by claiming they've already handled the most important demands. This is clearly another layer of elite coordination to string people along with empty promises and block any real protections that might threaten their control. The official line is just a cover to maintain power and dodge binding commitments that could disrupt their hidden agenda in education and beyond.
